general.text: Lifesteal heals in full up to 6% of max HP per second, and only 20% of the healing beyond that
details: Area damage against crowds no longer turns lifesteal into full healing every second
Unused full-strength healing builds up for up to 2 seconds
Regeneration, shields and other healing are not limited

general.text: Enemies speed up by 1% every five minutes instead of every minute
Enemies push each other apart lightly and no longer stack into one point
Added a new hero and six items: the roster now has 19 heroes and 71 items
All co-op players must update to the same game version

changes.text: New hero: Succubus
details: Every 12 s, charms the nearest ordinary enemy within 225 for 3 s; elites and bosses are immune
The charmed enemy attacks other enemies at 70% of its normal damage; its kills credit Succubus
Heroes and their attacks do not target the charmed enemy; hostile behavior resumes when charm ends
Per level: +0.1 s charm duration and −0.15 s cooldown
Health 135 (+2 per level), regeneration 1.25, movement speed 32, attack speed 25
Armor 3%, magic resistance 18%, damage 14 (+1.75 per level)
Unique appearance and animations: red skin, an open black outfit, tall boots, horns, wings and a tail

changes.text: Lifesteal heals in full up to 10% of max HP per second instead of the usual 6%
Attack speed reduced from 35 to 33
Base ability and item cooldown reduction increased from 10% to 12%
Base damage increased from 7 to 8
Base damage increased from 4 to 4.5
Damage growth per level increased from 0.35 to 0.45
Allied player and summon damage and attack-speed bonuses increased from 10% to 10.5%
Base damage increased from 10 to 11
Random stat growth per level: 0.75–8.25% → 1.25–8.25%
Fire-trail radius growth per level increased from 0.5 to 0.75
Base copy creation cooldown reduced from 16 to 14 s
Cooldown reduction per level increased from 0.05 to 0.1 s
Damage growth per level increased from 1.75 to 1.85
Maximum health growth per level reduced from 3 to 2
Base damage increased from 15 to 16.5
New mythic item: basic attacks deal 22% more damage to enemies with negative effects
details: Works against slow, stun, pending poison and armor reduction
The bonus does not stack between copies

changes.text: New epic item: every 12 s, pulls enemies within 300 toward the hero and stuns them for 2 s
New epic item: basic attacks reduce enemy armor by 8 percentage points for 3 s
details: Applies throughout the basic attack area, including projectile splash
Copies add armor reduction; repeated hits refresh the duration

changes.text: New epic item: increases the duration of negative effects you apply by 8% per copy
details: Extends slow, stun, poison delay, armor reduction and Succubus charm

changes.text: New rare item: basic attacks slow enemies by 4% for 3 s per copy
details: Applies throughout the basic attack area, including projectile splash
Repeated hits refresh the duration; slow is capped at 90%

changes.text: New rare item: doubles basic projectile size and its splash radius
details: For heroes with a basic melee attack, increases its radius instead
Each additional copy adds one more base size and radius

changes.text: Magic damage bonus increased from 5% to 6%
Copies no longer add lifesteal: each extra copy widens the radius by 15%
Several Vampire Hoods in a team do not add up: the strongest one in range applies

Lifesteal reduced from 35% to 15%
